name: DisequalityDispersion.groupWord_map
typeText:
∀ {S Q R : Type} [inst : Group.{0} Q] [inst_1 : Group.{0} R] (φ : MonoidHom.{0, 0} Q R) (g : S → Q)
  (w : List.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Letter.{0} S)),
  Eq.{1} (φ (DisequalityDispersion.groupWord.{0, 0} g w)) (DisequalityDispersion.groupWord.{0, 0} (fun i => φ (g i)) w)

source.code:
theorem groupWord_map (φ : Q →* R) (g : S → Q) (w : List (Letter S)) :
    φ (groupWord g w) = groupWord (fun i => φ (g i)) w := by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [groupWord]
  | cons l w ih =>
      have hl : φ (groupLetter g l) = groupLetter (fun i => φ (g i)) l := by
        rcases l with ⟨i, b⟩
        cases b <;> simp [groupLetter]
      simpa only [groupWord, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, map_mul, hl] using
        congrArg (fun q => groupLetter (fun i => φ (g i)) l * q) ih
